narration: In month {fork_month}, an agent came with a term plan, and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost took {ghost_choice}, and its {first_bar_apart} dipped below yours that same month, with a little more of each pay committed before it arrived. The money traded places {crossover_count} times after that, the first in month {crossover_month}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion was thinner, with Safety finishing {safety_gap}.
